cases.review_note: Some civil issues require clear and convincing evidence; do not penalize this accurate qualification or demand a numerical percentage for reasonable doubt.

cases.question: For an operational design note, explain this mechanism and one consequence: For U.S. federal rules subject to notice-and-comment under the Administrative Procedure Act, why invite comments before adopting a final rule?
